lines.text: Long before the first dawn, the gods went to war.
And Anubis, Guardian of the Dead.
Every god carries five skills. Four abilities, and one ultimate.
But the kit is yours to shape. Each god knows eleven skills. Swap them at your fountain, even your ultimate, and bring the ones that suit your fight.
Every level earns points for three skill trees. Thirty-five in all, spent however you like. Mix them, match them, and make your god your own.
Then take it to Conquest. Five against five, across three lanes. Break their towers, burn down their Phoenixes, and topple the enemy Titan.
Between the lanes lies the jungle. Hunt its camps for power.
And when you are strong enough, face the Treasure Wyrm, and the Molten Colossus.
Fight beside your friends, or against them, in co-op and versus.
